notes: The native tracker lives in tracker.c as a flat 512-entry array keyed by entity id; combat.c and the servertick's mob lanes decide when entries are created (tracker_add with class string "EntityLivingBase") and clientworld.c consumes the emitted packets. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): the re-watch loop is ported (DEVLOG 2026-09-25 lane/bot, the second loop on a four-block move); the rest is multiplayer; record is wrong. Formerly listed as missing: func_151247_a, func_151248_b, removePlayerFromTrackers and func_85172_a (the chunk-watch start for players entering a chunk) are missing. The per-class addEntityToTracker table is incomplete beyond the player/fishhook/arrow/item/falling-block/orb/mob rows. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was in_scope/exact: a reachable behaviour is not native (missing). lane/idxlast 2026-09-27: the per-class table was completed by lane/clientgate (items, orbs, arrows, thrown, eyes, squid) and lane/harness2 (the 144 clamp); only the bat is left, on lane/seed1chain.
